openings:
The strongest opening is the silence. An enterprise influencer agency whose record holds no client, no campaign, no move and no update to its site in 365 days, with Google ads last shown 2025-12-27 and LinkedIn ads still selling Holiday 2025, is likely, at moderate confidence, to be losing renewals to rivals who can show current work; the falsifier is a recompile showing new case studies, fresh ads and a resumed cadence.

Price is not the lever: Monsoon reads Doldrums at 24.2 with displacement 21.7, so an offshore rate attack is very unlikely to move creator relationship work. The lever is the one line. Breadth is 2, Paid Social scores 0 and Data & Measurement 1, so a rival that pairs creator networks with paid amplification and measurement that survives KJ4 undercuts a dashboard pitch with no measurement depth behind it. Pricing is open (P5 unknown): a transparent, outcome priced seeding offer, cost per verified creator, is a conversation Obviously cannot have in public. No contestable name can be listed because none is on record; beauty, food and beverage, lifestyle and retail are where its own ads say the buyers are.
